summary: The checkpoint of the show-your-work week: freeze new features, polish (a secret finder that checks the whole repository, documented example settings, a re-run of the fresh clone), record the three-minute demo, and write CV and LinkedIn text in which every claim can be shown. The final test is a stranger with only the link and a timer.
goal: Checkpoint: a stranger can run the project from the README.

items.text: Write the freeze list and the ticket list, and tag v1-freeze
Run the polish checks and fix what they find
Record the demo twice from a clean start and keep the better take
Write three CV bullets and a short LinkedIn text where every claim can be shown
Give a stranger the link and a timer and fix what they hit
Play the Freeze and Polish game to the end and see your score
